P14.2: bulk exports — computed-licence compartments, reproducible releases, Zenodo deposit, and egress-friendly distribution

Build the §38 bulk-export layer on top of the existing licence math
(policy.licensing) and crosswalk builders (resolution.crosswalk), never
re-implementing them — the same code path the read API uses, which is why exports
and API agree by construction (SIG-EXPORT-003). exports must not import api (api and
connectors depend on sig-exports), so "same code path" is the shared lower-level modules.

New exports modules:
- manifest: BuildSpec (as_of pair + ruleset + resolver) -> deterministic release_id /
  concept id; Artifact/Manifest with a SHA-256 per artifact (SIG-EXPORT-001/003).
- compartments: place each table in its computed licence compartment (SIG-LIC-004a);
  an incompatible share-alike mix FAILS the build (SIG-EXPORT-004/SIG-LIC-010); ODbL and
  CC-BY land in physically separate files (SIG-EXPORT-005); every row stamped with its
  per-row rights provenance (SIG-EXPORT-006/SIG-LIC-011).
- formats: seven deterministic writers — Parquet (DuckDB), CSV, JSONL, JSON-LD/RDF,
  SQLite/Datasette, GeoJSON, PMTiles (SIG-EXPORT-001).
- frictionless: Frictionless Data Package (tabular) + RO-Crate (evidence), disjoint sets.
- zenodo: quarterly deposit over a transport seam — concept + version DOIs, evidence
  bytes excluded by size, digest manifest deposited in their place (SIG-EXPORT-002).
- distribution: egress-first — a metered-egress store fails the build (SIG-EXPORT-008);
  BitTorrent-v2 magnet + IPFS CIDv1 for the largest artifacts (SIG-EXPORT-009).
- downstream: the six §38.4 application classes as validated design targets; conflicting
  needs served as separate artifacts (SIG-EXPORT-010/011).
- bundle + bundle_io + cli `build`: the reproducible orchestrator, JSON build request,
  and CLI (with a dry-run Zenodo deposit); crosswalk published separately under the most
  permissive licence its constituents allow (SIG-EXPORT-007).

policy.licensing: add public most_permissive_license (SIG-EXPORT-007), and make
effective_license fail closed on an UNRESOLVABLE upstream_license so a silently-travelling
share-alike obligation defaults to the stricter regime, never the declared permissive one
(SIG-LIC-009a). Both additive: no registered source sets upstream_license.

Docs: ADR-048; traceability matrix + risk register (RISK-P14-11..18) updated.

Requirement ids: SIG-EXPORT-001, SIG-EXPORT-002, SIG-EXPORT-003, SIG-EXPORT-004,
SIG-EXPORT-005, SIG-EXPORT-006, SIG-EXPORT-007, SIG-EXPORT-008, SIG-EXPORT-009,
SIG-EXPORT-010, SIG-EXPORT-011, SIG-LIC-009a, SIG-LIC-010, SIG-LIC-011.
